## Professional Summary

Ángel Calderón is a Software Architect and AI Engineer based in Caracas, Venezuela. He designs and builds web and mobile products with a focus on performance, user experience, security, and deployment automation. His expertise spans artificial intelligence (RAG, autonomous agents, LLM integration), cybersecurity (OSINT), full-stack web development, mobile development, and IoT systems.

## Featured Projects

### Andolimpio — Venezuelan Household Income Calculator
- **URL:** https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/andolimpio
- **Demo:** https://andolimpio.angelcalderon.dev
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Doble-2/andolimpio
- **Role:** Creator
- **Year:** 2026
- **Stack:** Astro, TypeScript, SVG, node:test, Vercel
- **Description:** Type what your household earns each month and see where it falls in Venezuela's income distribution, built on the ENCOVI 2025 survey (UCAB). The survey publishes only ten decile averages; a fitted curve reproduces them exactly, and every figure is cited to its source slide.

### Céflow — 3D Dental Planning in the Browser (Platanus Hack 26)
- **URL:** https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/ceflow
- **Demo:** https://ceflow-ph.onrender.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/platanus-hack/platanus-hack-26-ve-team-18
- **Role:** Developer (team of five, including a dentist)
- **Pitch video:** https://youtu.be/6mIvorbU_T0?t=7057
- **Year:** 2026
- **Award:** 5th of 22 teams, 3rd in technical execution, Platanus Hack 26 Caracas
- **Stack:** React, Three.js, TypeScript, Web Workers, DICOM, Vercel AI SDK, Playwright
- **Description:** Built in 36 hours. Dentists load intraoral scans (STL, OBJ, PLY) and CBCT scans (DICOM) and get a 3D planning draft in the browser, with no CAD license or dedicated GPU. Patients get an interactive report with their 3D model and an FDI odontogram.

### OSINT-D2 — Autonomous AI Agent for Identity Investigation
- **URL:** https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/osint-d2
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Doble-2/osint-d2
- **Documentation:** https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev
- **Role:** Creator & Security Engineer
- **Year:** 2025
- **Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Typer, Playwright, WeasyPrint, Docker, Ollama
- **Description:** Give it a username or email: an AI agent scans 20+ platforms, finds new leads, pivots on them on its own, and delivers an evidence-based profile (6 dimensions, 3 of them opt-in because they are sensitive) as a PDF dossier. Open source, Docker-ready, with the AI able to run locally via Ollama. Features 9 agent tools and 547 tests.

- **Year:** 2025

- **Description:** A comprehensive residential management platform bridging physical security hardware with modern cloud architecture. Designed to automate visitor access and streamline complex financial reporting for large-scale condominiums with 150+ units and real-time synchronization.

### Studia — AI-Powered EdTech SaaS

### Appod — NASA's Picture of the Day, Redesigned
- **URL:** https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/appod
- **Demo:** https://appod.angelcalderon.dev/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/Doble-2/Appod-AstronomyPictureOfDay
- **Role:** Creator
- **Year:** 2022 (first public repo 2024, redesigned in 2026)
- **Stack:** Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Vercel
- **Description:** A Flutter app for web and Android to explore NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day. Redesigned in 2026 around the photograph: a photo calendar, an endless 30-year archive, favorites and gesture-driven full-screen views. It reads NASA's real archive from science.nasa.gov, downloads 98% less image data and caches every day it has seen, so it also works offline.
